WFRPPD.Title: Equipment
WFRPPD.Hint: Drag an item onto a bag section to move it there. Bags go into the three slots on top. Double-click to equip/unequip, right-click to open.

Tooltip.Hint: Double-click to equip/unequip · Right-click to open
Tooltip.HasTable: Description has a table - right-click to open

Money.Title: Money
Money.ClickHint: LMB - add, RMB - remove, Shift - by 10. Change is made automatically.
Money.Rates: 1 Gold Crown = 20 Silver Shillings = 240 Brass Pennies. 1 Shilling = 12 Pennies.

Warn.NotOwned: Add the item to the character first, then equip it from the paperdoll.

Fly.BisHint: Best item you own for this slot

Stats.Modified: Modified: {mod} (effects, talents or a sheet edit)

Restr.UntrainedHint: No {skill} specialisation: the weapon loses its qualities, flaws stay
Restr.OffHandHint: Attacking with the off hand is penalised. Ambidextrous reduces it
Restr.CastHint: A caster takes -1 SL to Language (Magick) and Channelling per armour point on the most armoured location
Restr.CultUlric: Ulric: blackpowder, helmets, crossbows and technology are not the way of Ulric
Restr.ForbiddenHint: Not allowed by the rules - excluded from BIS
Restr.OffHandParryHint: Off-hand attacks are penalised. Melee (Parry) removes the penalty when defending. Ambidextrous reduces the attack penalty
Restr.NoAmmoHint: No matching arrows, bolts or shot in the inventory - nothing to shoot
Restr.LayerHint: Only Flexible armour or soft leather can be worn under other armour (p. 300). Two rigid layers on one location are up to the GM
Restr.SkillPenaltyHint: Each piece of mail or plate gives -10 Stealth. Helmets and coifs hinder Perception (p. 300)

Effects.HintDisable: Click to disable (e.g. left the area)
Effects.HintInjury: LMB - open · Shift+LMB - delete injury · RMB - details
Effects.DeleteConfirm: Delete the injury «{name}» from the character? This cannot be undone.

Talent.DualWielder: Dual Wielder: attacks with both hands

Bags.Full: "{bag}" can't fit it: {used} of {cap} used, item weighs {weight}.
Bags.NoFreeSlot: All three bag slots are taken. Remove one or swap via the arrow.
Bags.Overflow: More than three bags worn, not in slots: {names}
Bags.PackHint: Move the heaviest carried items into worn bags while there is room. Two-handed and polearm weapons stay out
Bags.PackNothing: Nothing to pack: heavy items are already in bags or don't fit
Bags.NoNesting: «{item}» is a bag and cannot go inside another bag.

ItemIcons.Name: Module item icons
ItemIcons.Hint: Replace wfrp4e-core placeholder icons (sack, sword, bow) with the module's drawn icons.

EncHint.Load: Load {current} of {max}. Encumbered above {max}, heavily above {x2}, above {x3} the character cannot move.
EncHint.Max: Over three times the limit: the character cannot move.
EncHint.Fatigue: after a day of travel - Fatigued
EncHint.Fatigue2: after a day of travel - Fatigued (2)
EncHint.Extra: gains 1 extra Fatigued when tired for any other reason

Kind.torn: torn muscle: unusable until it heals

Limb.MarvelHint: Engineering Marvel: the loss has no effect.
Limb.NoHandHint: By the rules this hand cannot hold a weapon, nor a two-handed one. You can still drag an item here if the GM allows it.
Limb.StumpHint: No hand: cannot hold a weapon, but a shield can be strapped to the stump. -20 to tests needing both hands.
Limb.HookHint: Hook: counts as a dagger in melee.
Limb.NoLegHint: Movement is reduced (core rules, Amputations). A false leg restores 1 Movement.
Limb.LegProsthesisHint: False leg: +1 to Movement lost with the leg.
Limb.TempHint: Temporary: the limit goes away when the injury heals.
Limb.LegDisabledHint: The leg does not work until the injury heals: Movement is reduced as if it were lost.

Mutation.GMHint: LMB (GM) - what it gives: hand / head / nothing / by name · RMB - open
Mutation.ExtraHint: Slot from the «{name}» mutation. The system does not know about extra limbs: the item is equipped, the module remembers where.

mutations.Name: Track mutations
mutations.Hint: Mutations in the effects strip, extra hands and heads as slots.

injuries.Name: Track limb injuries
injuries.Hint: Slot badges, "no hand" marks and prosthetics.

prices.Name: Show item prices
prices.Hint: Approximate value in tooltips. The GM always sees prices.

sounds.Name: Interface sounds
sounds.Hint: Coin clink when money is gained or spent.
